verdict.rationale: Lowenstein publishes a named startup program, "Lowenstein x Clerky," on its own site. The page covers Delaware C-corp formation and post-incorporation workflows, and its FAQ states prices: Post-Incorporation Setup at $299 pay-per-use or included in the Company Lifetime Package, plus a $149 managed 83(b) add-on. Missing for 10: the price of the incorporation step and the Company Lifetime Package, any deferred-fee or fixed legal-fee terms, clarity on whether the prices are platform or attorney fees, and independent corroboration.
